literal_meaning: চোখের পুতুল (চোখের পুতুল বা চোখের মণি)
example_sentences_in_bangla: বাবা তার ছেলেকে চোখের পুতুলের মতো আদর করে।
example_sentences_in_english: Her daughter is the apple of her eye.
The father pampers his son like the apple of his eye.
note: This idiom reflects deep familial bonds in Bengali culture, often used to express parental love.
